title: Machine Learning-Assisted Raman Spectroscopy for pH and Lactate Sensing in Body Fluids.
summary: Author institutional primary PDF Methods/Results: Raman PCA/PLS predicts pH and lactate in aqueous, pig blood and plasma; LOOCV errors reported (pH 0.04/0.05; lactate 0.32/1.25/0.51). Ex-vivo proof of concept, not patient diagnosis.
